_doc: Glosas EN cortas para el turista (fase 19, Carmen D/P2). Solo se ven en modo EN, bajo la descripción literal en español, que nunca cambia. Se resumen los ingredientes de la carta; no se traducen nombres.
Pinche Güey: [Mezcal, tequila, toasted-peanut horchata, merkén (smoked chili), grapefruit, lemon · smoky, a little spicy]
Aquí te las traigo Peter: [Pisco, elderflower liqueur, cranberry, lemon · topped with a smoke bubble]
Cómo te voy a olvidar: [Pear vodka, lemon, syrup, red wine float]
Guarever como sea: [Banana and coffee liqueurs, pisco, sour mix, coconut rum foam]
Not Collins: [Amaretto, syrup, lemon, soda · a sweeter take on the Tom Collins]
Te espero en la cuneta: [Blanco tequila, curaçao, lemon, pineapple · a sweeter take on the margarita]
Sagüer on Faia: [Spiced pisco sour with a little heat]
Sangría Foreva!: [Carménère wine, aged pisco, cinnamon syrup, fruit]
Tranquilein John Wayne: [Blended Scotch, apple juice, cinnamon syrup, lemon]
A veces me pongo Coquette: [Berry pisco, whisky cream liqueur, raspberry, orange, cinnamon · pink and creamy]
Iquique Glorioso: [Trä·kàl (Patagonian apple-pear spirit), pisco, passion fruit, mango, pineapple]
Otra cosa mariposa: [Cold brew coffee, passion fruit, cinnamon, ginger ale]
La moto chantá: [Mango, passion fruit, cucumber, lemon · salt rim]
Mojito sin alcohol: [Virgin mojito · try it with honey, ginger or passion fruit]
Pisco sagüer sin alcohol: [Alcohol-free pisco sour · try it with honey, ginger or passion fruit]
Tukulito Sakayama: [Marinated tuna tataki with house bread and sauce]
Una cosa poca: [Chilean-style baked cheese fondue with tomato, avocado and pesto, house bread]
La carne es débil: [Beef, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes in garlic oil, bread]
Con tuti si no pa qué!: [Sharing board: cheeses, mushrooms, avocado, olives, nuts, fruit]
A ponerle wendy!: [Big sharing platter: beef, chicken, vegetables, cheeses, serrano ham, pickles]
Eres tan exótica: [Shrimp and chicken in green curry and coconut, hummus, bread]
Todo que ver!: [Red tuna ceviche with avocado, pineapple, coconut and green curry, house bread]
Campestre: [Clay pot: mushrooms, parmesan, pesto, cream, roasted pepper]
Camarón que se duerme: [Clay pot: shrimp, cream cheese, mushrooms, ginger, white wine]
Muéveme el pollo: [Clay pot: chicken, cream, tomato, curry, peanuts, teriyaki · also comes veggie]
Chambreao: [Beef burger, cheese, caramelized onion, dill pickles, bourbon BBQ sauce, sourdough bun]
Hamburguesa Almud: [Lentil burger, avocado, tomato, greens, sourdough bun · vegan]
Cabrone: [Goat cheese, avocado, roasted red pepper, greens, sourdough ciabatta]
Blanquita: [White pizza: cream, mozzarella, avocado, caramelized onion, green chili, merkén · spicy]
Tartufita: [Goat cheese, tomato, roasted pepper, truffle oil]
Cabras a la higuera: [Goat cheese, figs, glazed cherry tomatoes, balsamic glaze]
Zorrona: [Beef chunks (200 g), red onion, garlic, mushrooms, greens]
Terrible pollo: [Chicken in pesto, cream cheese, tomato, onion, mushrooms]
La vaca Lola: [Kids: beef burger with cheese and tomato]
Pizza dulzona: [Sweet pizza: hazelnut spread, cream, red berries, almonds]
Topiturrón: [Chocolate nougat with cookies and nuts, orange-cranberry gel, berry sorbet]
Crumblecito ito ito: [Warm apple crumble, chocolate, nuts, cucumber ice cream]
